newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador looking at possibility of a Eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador looking at possibility of a Eurobond issue.

text.p: Ecuador is evaluating the possibility of launching another Eurobond issue, Central Bank General Manager Fidel Jaramillo said Thursday.
"The possibilities are open as a part of a series of initiatives the government may take to manage its foreign debts and in order to raise funds for investment projects," Jaramillo told journalists.
Ecuador issued its first-ever Eurobonds with a $500 million issue in April.
"If the government decides at any moment to carry out an operation of this nature, it will be informed at the time," he added.

Ecuador's debt issues surged Thursday after Moody's Investors Service assigned the country's foreign currency debt with its first ever credit rating. Ecuador was rated B1, the same level as Argentina and Brazil.
"It will be the finance minister who decides on the best time, when one can take advantage of international financing conditions to carry out new issues," Jaramillo said.
